edits.before: Full kit: Q-slow the trades, W the dives both directions, and thicken the margins.
edits.after: His W dash-in plus E flicker escape beats your slow, grounded engage every time.

edits.before: Zone with devour threat — the carry your Q stuns twice is the carry you eat.
edits.after: His W+E dash angles pick trades and disengage before your Devour threat lands.

edits.before: Abyssal Voyage online — your duo's roams arrive through the floor.
edits.after: The Quickness chains charms faster than your Devour recovers.

edits.before: First item: the gray health compounds and the stuns chain.
edits.after: His dash-tempo outpaces your immobile peel around objectives.

edits.before: Late Kench is the un-kill: eat the focused carry, wall the dive, and voyage the flanks.
edits.after: He picks the engage angle every fight; your single-target peel can't cover every flank.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Gleaming Quill heals his allies on hit — start Grievous Wounds before extended trades, not after.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with intentions.
edits.after: Committing burst into a banked Fey Feathers or Battle Dance shield — bait it out first, then all-in.

edits.before: - Rakan Grand Entrance: matchup-defining — The leap knockup starts every play — track him in fog; the E extends it. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your W Devour (ally save) answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Grand Entrance (W): 14-10s cooldown — track him in fog; a re-cast Battle Dance (E) extends the escape. - Gleaming Quill (Q) heals allies on hit — anti-heal timing matters. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
